'''Anhur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] who was a field [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Anhur was the chief of security at the [[Prison Geothermal Collectors]] in the [[High Security Section]] and led a contingent of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in defending the generators, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an Imperial assault.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Field Commander Anhur appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a major enemy that must be defeated in the Imperial Heroic mission "Lights Out."<ref name="TOR" />
